features: 270° Motorized Rotating Lens and Face Tracking: Use the button to rotate the lens through its 270° range and switch between selfie, forward-facing and side-angle views without manually turning the lens or repositioning the vlog camera. With face tracking enabled, the lens automatically rotates to follow a detected face and help keep the subject centered as they move. This is useful for solo vlogs, walk-and-talk videos and tutorials

Clear 5K Video and 90° Rotatable Touchscreen: Record in 5K/20fps when detail matters, choose 4K/60fps for smoother movement, or use 1080p/60fps for everyday recording. The 150° wide-angle lens fits more of the scene into the frame for travel and outdoor footage. The 90° rotatable touchscreen supports vertical and horizontal viewing positions for easier framing. Touch controls make settings easier to adjust directly on screen

Flexible Mounting and Hands-Free POV Recording: Use the 360° rotating clip to attach this portable camera to clothing, belts, backpack straps or compatible gear as a clip-on camera for hands-free recording. If the mounting point sits at an angle, rotate the clip to help keep the camera upright and footage level. The 1/4-inch threaded mounting socket works with compatible tripods, selfie sticks, handlebar mounts and action camera adapters

Steadier Video and Clearer Voice: Electronic image stabilization uses digital correction to help reduce visible shake in recorded footage. This makes handheld, walking and cycling videos look steadier and easier to watch. Use the built-in microphone for everyday recording. For clearer speech, connect the included USB-C external lavalier microphone and position it closer to the speaker for vlogs, interviews and voiceovers

Easy Control and Versatile Connectivity: Use the wireless remote to start or stop recording and rotate the lens when the camera is worn, mounted or hard to reach. Connect the camera to the app via Wi-Fi to preview framing, then review, download or share footage on your phone. USB-C supports fast charging, file transfer, recording while charging and webcam use on a PC. A 64GB memory card is included so you can record right away
